input.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS customer_id,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.sku,
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.status AS order_status,
  o.order_date,
  oi.id AS order_item_id,
  oi.quantity,
  oi.unit_price_cents,
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.amount_cents,
  r.reason,
  r.status AS refund_status,
  r.requested_at,
  r.evidence_submitted
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE c.name = 'Ava Thompson'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%'
input.intent: Look up Ava Thompson's refund record for Bluetooth Headphones, including refund status and evidence submitted.

output.sql_executed: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, p.name AS product_name, p.sku, o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.order_date, oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, r.id AS refund_id, r.amount_cents, r.reason, r.status AS refund_status, r.requested_at, r.evidence_submitted FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE c.name = 'Ava Thompson' AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%' LIMIT 500
